privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: About this policy

Call Capture provides optional microphone recording, call-notification or phone-state detection, and a local history of selected messaging notifications. This policy describes this version of the Android app. It is not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta, Messenger, Telegram or Google. Developer: {{DEVELOPER_NAME}}. Privacy contact: {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
Information processed on your device

When you choose recording, the app processes microphone audio and stores audio files with recording time, duration, size, app/call-type label, and caller or conversation labels supplied by a supported notification. User-entered notes and starred status are also stored. Cellular phone-state signals may indicate ringing, connected or idle, but this build does not request contacts or call-log access and does not promise caller identification.
Message notification history

After separate affirmative consent and Android notification access, the app saves new notification text, sender/conversation labels, source app and times for the WhatsApp or Messenger packages you select. Android access can expose a broader stream of notifications; this feature filters to its supported selected apps. Call detection separately inspects supported call notifications only when its channel is enabled. The app does not read chat databases, app screens or Accessibility content. It cannot recover old, hidden or protected messages, download chat media, or reliably identify which message was deleted or unsent. Android may redact sensitive text.
Purposes and optional access

Audio is used to create and play the recordings you enable. Call signals are used for call prompts and supported start/stop behavior. Notification text is used only for the local message-history feature. Permission and listener state are used for feature guidance. Microphone, phone state, app notifications and notification-listener access serve different purposes. Android permission approval and accepting Terms are not substitutes for the separate feature consents. You may decline optional features and still view saved recordings and messages.
How recording behaves

Automatic microphone start is attempted only while this app has a visible activity, the selected channel is enabled, microphone access is available and a connected-call signal is received. Otherwise an explicit tap-to-record prompt can bring you to the app. Recording captures microphone input; both sides of another app's call may be unavailable, silent or blocked. A matching call-notification removal or phone-idle event may stop the recording. Signals can be missed or inaccurate, so a visible Stop control remains important. Speakerphone routing changes occur only if you enable that separate option.
Storage and security

Saved audio and metadata use app-private device storage. Message history uses private SQLite storage in the app's no-backup directory. Current backup rules exclude recording files, app databases and preferences. Android sandboxing, device locking and operating-system storage protection help restrict access. This build does not add its own password vault, end-to-end encryption or application-level database encryption. No security control guarantees protection on a compromised, rooted or shared unlocked device. HTTP cleartext traffic is disabled. Sharing uses Android FileProvider with temporary read access to selected recordings.
Sharing, external links and third parties

There is no feature that automatically uploads audio files, notification messages or caller labels to the developer. This build does not request Android Internet access and contains no in-app updater, advertising SDK, analytics SDK or cloud-sync client. If you deliberately share a recording, the receiving app or recipient receives the selected file and its own policies apply. Exported or shared copies are outside this app's deletion controls. Opening a published policy or support link hands the action to another app, such as your browser or email app; that app may make network requests under its own policies. A support email opens a draft, and you choose whether to send it and what to include. Do not attach sensitive material unless necessary and intended.
Accounts, advertising and tracking

This build has no app account creation or login, advertising SDK, analytics SDK, cloud-sync account or sale of personal data. Local Terms receipts record the accepted document version and time; feature consents record their version/time locally. These receipts are not uploaded. Introducing accounts, analytics, ads, uploads or a new provider requires updating the implementation, disclosures and store declarations before use.
Retention

Recordings, recording metadata and notes remain until you delete them or remove the app. Empty or failed captures may be discarded; successful nonempty short recordings can be saved. Saved message entries are limited to 5,000 entries and a 30-day retention window. Older entries are pruned when message history is opened or updated, not by a guaranteed exact-time deletion scheduler. Individual message deletion leaves a one-way deduplication identifier, without the message text, for up to that retention window to prevent replay from re-posted notification bundles. Delete all message history also removes these identifiers. Local settings and consent receipts remain until withdrawal, Android Clear storage or app removal, as applicable.
Your controls and deletion

Records supports deleting individual or selected audio entries. Messages supports pausing, choosing apps, deleting individual copies and deleting all message history. Settings > Manage local data can pause features, withdraw the Terms receipt, or stop capture and delete saved recordings/messages. A destructive action requires confirmation. If an audio file cannot be removed, the app reports incomplete deletion and keeps its row for retry. Pausing or withdrawing consent does not itself delete saved content. Android settings can revoke permissions at any time. Deleting local content does not delete source chats, recipients' copies, exports or copies saved elsewhere. You can also use Android Clear storage or uninstall to remove this app's private local data; Android controls those operations.
Children and lawful use

The app is not designed for children or use as a child-monitoring service. Use it only if you meet the applicable age and legal-capacity requirements. Do not install or use it covertly on another person's device. Obtain any notices, agreement or authorization required for recording and handling other people's communications in your location. One user's permission does not remove other people's rights.
Changes and contact

Policy changes will be reflected by a new document version. Changes to data access or purposes require appropriate updated disclosures and affirmative consent before the changed processing begins. For questions or privacy requests, contact {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} or the developer contact in the official store listing. The published policy URL is {{PRIVACY_URL}}. This local-only build cannot retrieve private recordings from your device remotely; use the in-app deletion controls for local copies. Any support correspondence you choose to send is handled through the contact channel you select.

terms.title: Terms of Use
sections: Agreement and scope

These Terms govern your use of Call Capture, provided by {{DEVELOPER_NAME}}. Review the Privacy Policy separately. Choosing Agree to Terms records your agreement locally; it does not grant Android permissions, enable recording channels or authorize message-history collection. Each optional feature has its own disclosure and controls. If you do not agree, you may view or delete existing local data without enabling new capture.
What the app provides

The app manages local microphone recordings, optional notification/phone-state call signals and optional selected message-notification history. Records, Messages and Settings provide playback, search, status, access guidance and deletion. No Accessibility service, screen scraping, direct third-party chat database access, system-only call-audio permission or secret monitoring feature is provided.
Eligibility and authority

Use the app only on a device you own or are explicitly authorized to control, with capacity to agree to these Terms. It is not a service for children. You are responsible for understanding and obtaining the agreement, notice and authority required to record audio or retain communications. Do not treat the device owner's approval as automatic consent from every participant.
Prohibited use

Do not use the app for stalking, harassment, spying, blackmail, unauthorized employee or partner surveillance, credential collection, fraud, unlawful interception or disclosure, or evasion of Android privacy and security controls. Do not falsely claim that a saved notification proves an unsent message, that permission health proves device security, or that the app guarantees two-way call recording. Do not redistribute another person's private audio or messages without appropriate authority.
Important technical limitations

Features depend on Android version, device manufacturer, source-app behavior, microphone availability, notification delivery and permissions. Call signals can be missing, delayed or mistaken. Calls may produce microphone-only, partial, silent or failed audio. A deleted source message remains here only if a copy was captured earlier from an eligible notification. The app cannot recover every deleted message, hidden content, media, old chats or protected audio. Use Stop yourself if automatic stopping does not occur. Do not rely on the app as an emergency service, legal-evidence guarantee, critical archive or substitute for backups you control.
Your data and sharing choices

You retain whatever rights you have in the content you lawfully create or save; the app does not grant rights in other people's content. Sharing is your deliberate action and may disclose the selected recording outside the app. Deleting data here cannot recall copies already exported, shared, backed up elsewhere or received by another party. Review the Privacy Policy for storage, retention and deletion behavior.
Permissions and withdrawal

You may decline optional access, pause features, revoke Android permissions and remove saved copies. Disabling one feature does not necessarily disable another; use Manage local data to pause all new capture. Withdrawing agreement stops new capture through this build's consent gates and leaves existing local files available for viewing or deletion. Android permission grants must be revoked separately in Android Settings.
Availability and updates

The app is provided subject to its stated capabilities and applicable mandatory rights. No promise is made that a call will be detected, both participants will be audible, every message will be retained, all devices will behave alike or a store will approve distribution. Updates can change compatibility. Read updated notices before enabling materially changed functionality. The current build has no paid subscription or in-app purchase; these Terms do not authorize undisclosed fees. The app does not download or install its own replacement APK. A Play-distributed edition must use Google Play's update mechanism.
Responsibility and mandatory rights

Use reasonable care when enabling, recording, sharing and deleting. The app does not eliminate your responsibility for lawful use or provide individualized legal advice. Nothing in these Terms excludes rights or remedies that applicable law does not allow to be excluded, or purports to excuse unlawful developer conduct. This text does not select an invented jurisdiction, waive mandatory consumer protections or promise that consent makes every recording lawful.
Third-party services and trademarks

WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Android, Google Play are third-party products or services. Their owners do not sponsor or endorse this app. Their own terms and technical restrictions continue to apply. Source-app or platform changes can affect this app without advance notice.
Ending use and contact

You may stop using or remove the app at any time. Use the local deletion tools before removal if you want to review what is deleted. No remote app account exists in this version. For support, privacy concerns or Terms questions, contact {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}. The published Terms URL is {{TERMS_URL}}. These Terms and feature disclosures should be reviewed again when the document version or data practices change.

data.title: Data Retention and Deletion
sections: No app account to delete

This build does not create an app account or store your recordings in a developer cloud account. Local-data deletion is available in the app. An account-deletion web request would become necessary if a future version introduces in-app account creation; no nonexistent account-deletion service is claimed here.
Recordings

Open Records to delete individual or selected recordings. Audio, associated metadata and notes remain until deletion or app removal, except empty/failed captures. Shared/exported copies are outside the app's control.
Messages

Open Messages > Manage history to pause saving or delete all saved notification text. Individual delete removes the text and retains a temporary one-way identifier to suppress replay from notification bundles. Delete all removes text and those identifiers. Retention is bounded by 30 days and 5,000 entries, with pruning on read/write rather than a timed guarantee.
Pause or withdraw

Pause all features turns off call channels and message saving and requests that an active recording stop. It does not revoke Android access or erase saved copies. Withdraw Terms also clears the local agreement receipt and prevents new feature capture until review and renewed opt-in. Existing local data remains available to view or delete.
Delete saved recordings and messages

Settings > Manage local data offers a confirmed deletion action. It pauses capture, waits for an active recording to finish saving and then removes local saved recordings/messages. Settings, document files and the app itself are not removed. If saving times out or a file cannot be deleted, the app reports failure or partial completion; it does not claim successful complete deletion.
Other copies and device operations

Deletion does not affect the original WhatsApp/Messenger chats, other apps, shared files, recipients, exports, screenshots or backups you made outside this app. Revoking Android permissions prevents future access but does not delete existing copies. Android Clear storage or uninstall removes private app data; Android controls those operations. Physical secure erasure of flash storage is not guaranteed by an ordinary file delete.
Privacy requests

For questions about the app or a support message you sent, contact {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}. We cannot remotely inspect or delete files in this local-only app. Use the in-app controls, or Android app storage controls, for private local data.

safety.title: Recording and Privacy Notice
sections: Before enabling a feature

Make sure you understand the data it needs and have authority to use it. Obtain any required participant agreement before recording. Keep recording indicators and the Stop control visible. Never install the app covertly on someone else's device.
What is not guaranteed

Permissions do not guarantee microphone availability, both sides of a call, automatic start/stop or complete notification delivery. Permission health is access guidance, not a security certificate. A saved notification is not proof that a source message was deleted.
Keep your data private

Use a device screen lock, protect your phone from unauthorized access, review recipients before sharing, and delete unnecessary recordings. App-private storage does not protect data from a compromised operating system or a person using your unlocked device. This app does not offer its own encrypted vault.
Your choices stay separate

Agreeing to Terms does not start capture. Granting Android access does not by itself enable message history. Message-history consent is separate from call alerts and recording. You can pause features, delete local copies and revoke access.
